summary: Full backend + frontend integration testing for RES corporate website + admin CMS. Backend: 28/28 pytest tests passed covering health, all public endpoints (home/about/services/projects/team/blogs/settings/capability), enquiry submission with validation, admin auth (login by ID and email, wrong-creds 401, /me cookie session, logout, CSRF enforcement on writes), dashboard counts (24 projects/4 services/6 team), full CRUD for services/projects/team/blog with draft->publish public visibility check, enquiries admin list + New->Read auto-flip on GET + status/note PATCH + CSV export, homepage & website_settings singleton save with public reflection, media PNG upload + non-image rejection, capability PDF upload + public retrieval + non-PDF rejection, change password round-trip (reverted to ResAdmin@2026). Frontend: 11/11 UI flows passed via Playwright — home hero+services, services list & detail-by-slug, 24 project cards + search filter + detail-by-slug, team page shows seeded members, about renders mission/vision, contact form submits and shows confirmation, wrong-creds shows 'Invalid credentials' error, correct login redirects to /admin/dashboard showing '24' project count, session survives refresh, admin enquiries nav works, logout redirects to /admin/login when hitting protected route. Additional admin UI checks: Homepage editor save-homepage button posted successfully (proves axios CSRF interceptor auto-attaches X-CSRF-Token), enquiries export-csv button present, all admin nav links (Homepage/About/Services/Projects/Team/Blog/Enquiries/Media/Capability PDF/Website Settings/SEO/Legal/Change Password) rendered. Console shows benign 401s from /api/admin/auth/me polls on public pages (expected behavior — check-if-logged-in probe).

issues: Frontend calls /api/admin/auth/me on every public page which produces 401 console errors for unauthenticated visitors. Not user-visible but adds noise. Consider gating the me() call to admin routes only, or swallowing 401 silently.

action_items: (Optional) Restrict /api/admin/auth/me polling to admin route context to remove 401 console noise on public pages.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 589 lines and mixes auth routes, generic CRUD factory, enquiries, singletons, uploads, dashboard, public routes, sitemap. Split into routers/ (auth, admin_content, public, uploads, enquiries) for maintainability if it grows.

Change-password endpoint currently accepts any non-empty new password (backend has no upper+lower+numeric complexity validation). The problem statement required upper+lower+numeric validation. Frontend likely does client-side check only. RECOMMEND: add server-side password strength validation in change_password() as well.
Enquiries duplicate-detection window is 60s, which is fine; rate-limit is 3/min per IP. Good.
Public /public/projects response shape mixes items+facets — well designed; ensure frontend Projects page consumes it correctly (verified visually 24 cards render).
CSRF double-submit + HttpOnly JWT cookie + bcrypt hashing + lockout after 5 attempts all correctly implemented per auth playbook.

seed_data_creation: Tests created transient TEST_ prefixed enquiries, projects, services, team members, and one blog post (draft->published->deleted). One TEST enquiry + one UI Test enquiry remain in DB for visibility validation; safe to leave. Website Settings company_name was appended with a TEST-XXXX tag by the settings reflection test — this may need to be reverted by main agent if desired, though value still starts with 'Resilient Earth Solutions'.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend test file at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py runs 28 tests in ~7s in parallel (2 workers). Uses REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL from env. Note that /api/public/settings returns {settings, seo} and /api/public/home has key 'home' (not 'settings'). Note also website_settings PUT test appends TEST-XXXX to company_name each run — consider snapshotting/restoring in future iterations if this becomes disruptive.
rca of the issue: No production bugs found. Two initial test failures were test-assumption issues on public API response shape (fixed): /public/home returns 'home' key (singleton) not 'settings', and /public/settings wraps in {settings, seo} envelope.
